extra.final_summary:
Penguins measured per island (52 rows after cleaning): Biscoe 28, Dream 16, Torgersen 8.

Problems found and fixed:
1. Island label variants (3 cells): "Dream " (trailing space), "Bisco" and "Torgerson" (misspellings). Merged into the allowed labels Biscoe/Dream/Torgersen with normalize_labels (approved). Without this, counts would have been split across 6 bogus island values.
2. Exact duplicate rows: rows 6 and 16 were identical copies of earlier rows (same penguin_id P1543905 etc.). Dropped with drop_duplicates (approved) so no penguin was counted twice.

Caveats / left alone (not needed for this question):
- body_mass_g is stored as text with thousands separators ("3,300") in 3 cells; it parses 100% numerically, so it is usable but not yet cast to a number.
- sex has a case variant "FEMALE" (1 row) vs "female"; harmless for island counts.
- flipper_length_mm and year are also stored as text in the raw file but are fully numeric-parseable.
- bill_depth_mm has no rule range in the rules file, so it was not range-checked; bill_length_mm (34.6–59.6) and flipper_length_mm (172–230) are within the allowed ranges.
